meta.title: Leaderboard competition design — rewards for top-performing, gate-validated strategies
meta.note: Modeled on official competition platforms: Kaggle's public/private leaderboard split (anti-overfitting) and the NFL's own Big Data Bowl on Kaggle, which awards $100,000 in prizes with judging by NFL club analytics staff. Our leaderboard uses the same structure: a public scoreboard on a sample window and a private (final) ranking on a held-out window, with rewards for the top gate-passing strategies.

rows.name: Competition structure
rows.description: Strategies compete weekly during the 2026 season; each strategy's bets are logged automatically with timestamps, prices and closing prices

rows.name: Public leaderboard (in-season)
rows.description: Ranks strategies on a sample of the current window (e.g., season-to-date) using mean CLV + ROI; visible to all participants — explicitly NOT the final ranking (avoid chasing the public board)

rows.name: Private leaderboard (final)
rows.description: Final ranking computed on the held-out remainder (e.g., the last 4 weeks / playoff weeks never used for tuning); this is the official ranking that determines rewards — mirrors Kaggle's private leaderboard
rows.metric: Mean CLV on holdout (primary), then holdout ROI

rows.name: Eligibility gate for leaderboard entry
rows.description: A strategy appears on the leaderboard only after passing validation gates G1–G8 (official data only, out-of-sample pass, significance vs break-even, min sample, positive CLV, Bonferroni correction, correlation/bankroll, settlement integrity)

rows.name: Rewards model
rows.description: Top-performing gate-validated strategies earn rewards — following the NFL Big Data Bowl precedent of cash prizes for top leaderboard finishers ($100,000 pool, NFL-judged) and Kaggle's prize-pool competitions; reward tiers: 1st / 2nd / 3rd on the private leaderboard, plus a ‘most improved CLV’ award

rows.name: Anti-cheat / anti-overfit rules
rows.description: No tuning on the private window; no future-information leakage (automatic disqualification); duplicate strategies from the same owner counted once; all bet logs auditable against official stats

rows.name: Metrics definition
rows.description: CLV = bet price vs closing price at the same book/market (positive = beat the close); ROI = net profit / total staked; win rate reported alongside the price-implied break-even (e.g., 52.38% at -110) with the NIST binomial test p-value
rows.metric: CLV, ROI, win rate vs break-even, N, p-value
